lines: Composer; Johnny Elmore
Mighty is the Lord, our God,
Give praise to His great name, great name;
Saints of earth, and hosts of heaven
Proclaim abroad His fame;
Come rejoicing, shout "Hosanna"
That all men might see;
Mighty is the Lord who lives eternally.
Holy is the Lord of Hosts,
Whose reign shall never cease,
He can save the fallen race
And give His servants peace;
All the earth should sing His praises,
For He makes us free;
Mighty is the Lord who lives eternally.
Mighty is our God, Jehovah,
Wondrous is His grace,
He is building now in heaven,
That we might have a place;
How He makes us want to serve Him,
His own people be;
Mighty is the Lord who lives eternally.
Mighty is the Lord,
The Lord who dwells in the heavens,
Mighty is the gracious Lord
Who rules over the sea;
Mighty is the Lord of Hosts
Who doth never slumber,
Mighty is the Lord who lives eternally.
